title: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body

entities.name: Ixhel
entities.description: A winged Phyrexian warrior of the Fair Basilica created by Atraxa, sent to kill Geth, who instead creates a new being from his head.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor created by Elesh Norn who made Ixhel and orders Geth's death.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The praetor who rules New Phyrexia and whose throne sits empty during Ixhel's audience.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: One of the seven Steel Thanes of the Dross Pits, a lich with an organic, incompleat head who deals in contracts and defies the Orthodoxy; Ixhel beheads him.

entities.name: Belaxis
entities.description: A talkative half-compleated aspirant bound by contract to Geth, who guards his gate and helps Ixhel; she later sacrifices him on the Dominus of Pain.

entities.name: Vishgraz
entities.description: A being Ixhel creates from Geth's head, with Belaxis's body, and arachnid limbs including her own wings; she names him and frees him.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A praetor, inventor and visionary who owns the Surgical Bay.

entities.name: Dominus of Pain
entities.description: A living, razor-edged monolith in the Dross Pits that feeds on screams of the impaled.

entities.name: Skitterlings
entities.description: Small clinging Phyrexian creatures that Ixhel kills.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: A sphere of New Phyrexia of glowing necrogen pools, home to the Steel Thanes.

entities.name: Fair Basilica
entities.description: Elesh Norn's serene, bright seat of power.

entities.name: Hunter Maze
entities.description: A sphere above the Dross Pits from which Belaxis comes.

entities.name: Surgical Bay
entities.description: Jin-Gitaxias's sphere where Ixhel makes Vishgraz.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-ruled plane divided into spheres.

entities.name: Geth's fortress
entities.description: A colossal black bone and red sinew fortress in the Dross Pits with an imitation throne.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: The Phyrexian order that Ixhel serves.

entities.name: Steel Thanes
entities.description: The seven rulers of the Dross Pits.

events.summary: Ixhel flies up the Basilica's shaft from the Dross Pits, killing skitterlings on the way, to report her success.
events.quote: as you separate their heads from their bodies with a sweep of your spear

events.summary: Atraxa orders Ixhel to seek out and kill the traitor Geth, a Steel Thane of the Dross Pits.
events.quote: I want you to seek him out, Ixhel. I want you to end him.

events.summary: Atraxa tells Ixhel she is her most perfect creation, and Ixhel feels a flare of something beyond loyalty.
events.quote: You are my most perfect creation.

events.summary: Ixhel treks across the Dross Pits and finds a rock gate with sound plates in front of Geth's fortress.
events.quote: Stepping into the shadow of the rock face, you see the outline of a gate.

events.summary: Ixhel pins a stammering aspirant who says he is Belaxis and has a contract with Lord Geth, whom he calls the Thane of Contracts.
events.quote: Lord Geth makes deals. That's why they call him the Thane of Contracts!

events.summary: Belaxis helps Ixhel crack the sound puzzle to open the gate and she gives him her name.
events.quote: The door flashes with a thin blue light, and the gate grinds open.

events.summary: Ixhel walks through Geth's holding, noting the many aspirants and incompleat creatures, and reaches his fortress and empty throne.
events.quote: you do see more aspirants than you have in a long time.

events.summary: Geth ambushes Ixhel, whom he mocks as a foot soldier, and speaks of loyalty that can be bought.
events.quote: The only true loyalty is that which can be bought.

events.summary: Geth asks what Ixhel will have beyond her orthodoxy and the love of her mother, and chokes her.
Ixhel opens her own throat on Geth's blade to break free and beheads him.
events.quote: you bring down your blade in a single stroke, parting his head from his body.

events.summary: Ixhel decides to help Geth's head and carries it to the Dominus of Pain.
events.quote: Maybe, in this, you can help him.

events.summary: Ixhel impales Belaxis on a spike of the Dominus of Pain, saying she is grateful.
events.quote: A piercing wail rings out across the wastes as you pin the writhing body in your arms down onto a razor-tipped spoke

events.summary: Ixhel uses the Surgical Bay to create a new being from the parts she took, and brings it to Atraxa.
events.quote: Except this time, you have made something.

events.summary: Atraxa reacts with disdain, and Ixhel admits she wanted to make something, and names her creation Vishgraz.
Atraxa orders Ixhel to get rid of it and leaves.
Ixhel realizes the new being carries Geth's head and her own wings, and tells him she wanted to save him.
Ixhel brings Vishgraz to the Dross Pits shaft and tells him to go, and he urges her to come; she refuses and calls him her first defiance.
events.quote: You are my first defiance. Now go.

events.summary: Ixhel stays at the base of the shaft, feeling an ache to follow him, but does not.
events.quote: Deep in the center of you is an ache that wishes to follow him.

relations.note: Atraxa fashioned Ixhel as a weapon.
relations.quote: I fashioned a weapon. That's what you are.
Elesh Norn decides what is true, and Atraxa speaks with her voice.
She is the only true voice you will ever answer to.

relations.note: Ixhel makes Vishgraz in the Surgical Bay.
relations.quote: You have made something, and you bring it home with you.
you bring down your blade in a single stroke, parting his head from his body.

relations.note: Ixhel impales Belaxis on the Dominus.
relations.quote: pin the writhing body in your arms down onto a razor-tipped spoke

relations.note: Belaxis guards Geth's gate by contract.
relations.quote: And now I guard the gate to his holdings.

relations.note: Geth is one of the seven Steel Thanes.
relations.quote: Geth is one of the seven Steel Thanes of the Dross Pits

relations.note: Ixhel is of the Fair Basilica's order.
relations.quote: the just desire to spread the Machine Orthodoxy across the Multiverse

relations.note: Geth refused to submit; Elesh Norn hates his head.
relations.quote: I assume the Mother has finally sent you for my head,
